overall_summary: Data volume is extremely small (4 videos, total 25 views) with minimal user interaction. Early indications show slightly higher initial reach on betrayal/relational themes ('बेवफाई') posted in early evening hours, but overall confidence is low, requiring controlled exploration.

winning_patterns.pattern: Relatable digital-age heartbreaks ('नंबर पर अभी भी तेरी तस्वीर है')
winning_patterns.evidence: Video 'a9-G1X5jEOU' achieved the highest view count (15 views) compared to generic late-night atmospheric hooks.
winning_patterns.action: Focus on tangible, modern personal items (chat histories, saved photos, contact names) as relatable triggers.

weak_patterns.pattern: Generic time-based hooks without immediate narrative tension ('रात के दो बजे')
weak_patterns.evidence: Video 'G0gKV1p3ZHc' received 0 views, indicating early drop-off or lack of immediate curiosity.
weak_patterns.action: Replace abstract atmospheric setups with concrete physical actions or micro-dramas in the first 2 seconds.

next_video.concept: Deleting a long unsent apology draft after seeing the person online and active elsewhere.
next_video.opening_direction: Show typing a long text message in a chat box late at night.
next_video.twist_direction: Instead of hitting send, selecting all text, hitting backspace, and changing their contact nickname back to their real name.
next_video.reason: Aligns with peak leisure hours for emotional Hindi content consumers and follows the relative performance peak seen around 13:47 UTC.

experiment: Testing if visual micro-interactions (typing/deleting a message) perform better than static background storytelling.
